format: assembly (ARM embedded assembly within a C-like macro structure)
description: This file contains ARM assembly code implementing a function to flush the Data Cache (D-cache) on ARMv7 architecture, specifically for Broadcom devices with a known broken bootloader. It is part of the Linux kernel's architecture-specific code, particularly initialization routines related to cache management.

methods.name: v7_flush_dcache_all
methods.description: Function to flush the entire Data Cache (D-cache) on ARMv7 CPUs, ensuring memory ordering and cache coherency.
